summary: Almonty Industries filed a Form 6-K reporting its Q1 2026 financial results and operational highlights. Revenue increased 221% to $25.4 million driven by record tungsten pricing. The company reported positive operating cash flow of $9.7 million and cash of $259.9 million. The filing includes a press release, interim financial statements, and MD&A. No corporate transaction, strategic review, or special situation is announced. This is a routine periodic earnings report by a foreign private issuer.
